summary: Might and Magic entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Dark Messiah of Might and Magic
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with compatibility fixes documented

primary.why: Dark Messiah is a first-person Arkane/Ubisoft action RPG built around PC mouse/keyboard combat and Source-engine physics. The Xbox 360 Elements version is a distinct port, but PC is the better original-route capture target.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version with current compatibility fixes. Record storefront, patch, widescreen/FOV fixes, difficulty, class/skill build, save route, physics quirks, and whether Xbox 360 Elements was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console port with altered structure/classes and console controls
secondary.why: The PC version is the original and stronger capture route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PC route with mouse/keyboard and Source-engine physics.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and best capture/control route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Xbox 360 Elements port differs, but the PC original is the recommended archive route for controls, physics, and capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Log FOV/widescreen fixes and do not merge Xbox 360 Elements progress with the PC route.
